pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal patches with softened, medium-gradient edges. Spatial area is heterogeneous, with larger, elongated patches on the mid-flank and significantly smaller, more rounded patches toward the posterior and upper limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Wide, cream-colored negative-space network with high topological continuity. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and tetra-radial intersections with consistent pixel thickness across the torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the neck and withers, appearing as a dense, uniform brush-like texture.
